zh.summary: 更新正式版默认插件，修复全屏退出后的窗口边界，并为 rc.2 独立内核资格补齐历史会话兼容。
highlights: 图片查看器升级至 0.1.3、会话管理升级至 1.5.2；同一发布包已在 alpha.1 和 rc.2 上验证关键操作。
修复 Windows 从最大化进入全屏再退出时，窗口仍覆盖任务栏区域的问题。
对精确版本和文件摘要绑定的 rc.2 迁移模块增加旧 descriptor-v2 读取兼容，并验证继续执行、保存重开和中断恢复。
upgradeNotes: 内置内核仍为 0.1.7-alpha.1；rc.2 须经本产品基线的五平台独立资格后才进入内核更新列表。
knownIssues: 完整多屏与混合 DPI 硬件组合、物理断电恢复尚未完成专项验收。

en.summary: Update stable default plugins, restore maximized window bounds after fullscreen, and prepare historical-session compatibility for separate rc.2 core qualification.
highlights: Bundle Image Viewer 0.1.3 and Session Manager 1.5.2, with critical operations verified against both alpha.1 and rc.2.
Fix maximized Windows windows retaining fullscreen bounds over the taskbar after leaving fullscreen.
Extend the exact version-and-digest-bound descriptor-v2 read adapter to rc.2, with continuation, persisted reopen and interrupted journal recovery checks.
upgradeNotes: The bundled core remains 0.1.7-alpha.1. rc.2 enters the core update list only after independent five-platform qualification against this product baseline.
knownIssues: The complete multi-monitor/mixed-DPI hardware matrix and physical power-loss recovery remain unqualified.
